## Checklist

- [ ] The change is limited to what this pull request describes.
- [ ] Tests pass, or I explained above why they could not be run.
- [ ] If I changed `cca.zsh` or `cca.ps1`, I made the matching change in the other one, or explained why not.
- [ ] I updated the README, `docs/` and the Unreleased section of `CHANGELOG.md` where behaviour changed.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, real emails, transcripts or other personal data are included.
- [ ] Existing behaviour is unchanged unless this pull request says otherwise.
- [ ] Platform-specific limitations are documented.
